candidates.what_happened: Nieman Lab reported on 18 Nov 2026, from a 6 Nov town hall, that McClatchy plans Project Catalyst, an 'AI-native operating model' with about a dozen internal AI tools. Its content scaling agent repackages human-written articles at different lengths with the reporters' names attached; Originality.ai estimated up to 20% of recent McClatchy articles were AI-generated, while executives said 'humans are at the command center'.
